question: Did training on grammar rejections (O89) make the tagger's first guesses acceptable more often? Redwoods dev, 2,062 sentences, same parser defaults (quiet2 / current).
verdict: First-guess gain (+12) is within the seed spread; within-5 gain (+31) is just above the two-seed range, suggestive only. Accepted sooner, but not more often right: consistent with the negatives (labels differing from gold, not labels the grammar rejects) pushing toward other licensed analyses.
